Theme

Latin word

domesticus

domesticus, domestica, domesticum

of the house and household; family, private; of one’s own country, native, internal (opposed to foreign)

In this lexicon

  • domestic

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fin. 2.77: aliam domesticam, aliam forēnsem; Tac. Dial. 34.1: domesticā disciplīnā

  • domestic

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 2.26: externa libentius in tālī rē quam domestica recordor; Caes. BG 2.10.4: domesticae cōpiae reī frūmentāriae (Lewis & Short)

  • amictus domesticus: dressing gown

    modern
